playbook_anchor: Draft crosswalk to the playbook's regulatory landscape and monitoring commitments. This is a scanner-source map only; it is not an approved Council register, legal applicability decision, assurance state, or record of a Council decision.
note: expectation governs scanner monitoring only. must-watch means a source is expected for monitoring; reference means a source may be retained for context. live/dark/gap is computed from sources.json verification_status and says nothing about legal applicability, compliance, approval, or action required. Every system and tier still needs case-specific screening by the responsible owners.
